description.value: Westerlea Resort Motel is a roadside motel situated on West Island Highway on Vancouver Island, positioned along a popular cycling corridor between Parksville and Qualicum Beach. Its location on the Island Highway places it directly on a common touring route for cyclists travelling the length of Vancouver Island. Guests would find it a convenient overnight stop in a stretch of the island known for scenic coastal riding.
